tools.name: get_authoring_guide
tools.description: Returns Docmino's MDX authoring documentation for document and page content, including supported interactive component props and working examples. The default guide covers common components; a component selection returns focused schemas and examples with companion components included automatically.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search document names and summaries accessible to your connected Docmino account. Returns up to 20 IDs, titles, canonical links, and hasMore; it does not search full page content. Use list_documents for workspace filters or pagination, then get_document for editable content.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Retrieve a document by ID as a text result containing its serialized document snapshot, canonical link, and revision. For large documents, metadata.complete is false and text provides retrieval instructions instead of content; use list_pages and read_page. Use get_document for a structured editable

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: List your personal account and a page of organization workspaces, returning their IDs and names. Use these IDs as workspaceId in document and project tools. Pagination applies to organizations; this tool does not create workspaces or manage membership.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: List or search documents accessible in a workspace, returning metadata, canonical links, permissions, and pageInfo rather than page content. Omit workspaceId for your personal account; use an ID from list_workspaces for an organization. Use get_document to read a result and offset/limit to paginate.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List accessible projects, including shared projects, in a personal or organization workspace. Returns project IDs, names, descriptions, instructions, permissions, and pageInfo; omit workspaceId for your account. Use list_project_documents to browse a project’s documents.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Read a project’s metadata, instructions, edit/manage permissions, and canonical link by project ID. Does not include its documents; use list_project_documents for those. Fails if the project is missing or inaccessible.

tools.name: list_project_documents
tools.description: List a page of accessible documents in a project by project ID. Returns document metadata, canonical links, permissions, and pageInfo, without page content. Use get_document for a document snapshot and offset/limit for the next page.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Read a document by ID, returning its structured MDX content, full nested page tree, metadata, permissions, canonical link, and current revision. Use this before update_document and preserve pages you are not changing. For oversized results use list_pages and read_page; use open_document to display t

tools.name: open_document
tools.description: Display a document by ID in the embedded Docmino editor on clients that support MCP Apps. Returns the same document snapshot, revision, permissions, and canonical link as get_document. Opening does not save changes; editing requires write access and an explicit Save. Use get_document for programmati

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List document page IDs, names, nesting, and content lengths without page bodies. Returns the current revision, rootContentLength, totalCount, and hasMore. Use read_page for root or child content; pass this revision as expectedRevision across subsequent reads to detect concurrent edits.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Read a chunk of raw MDX from a document’s root or a child page. Omit pageId for root content; obtain child IDs from list_pages. Returns revision, totalLength, and nextOffset; continue at nextOffset until null and reuse expectedRevision across chunks. A revision conflict requires restarting retrieval

tools.name: create_document
tools.description: Creates a Docmino document with MDX content and an optional nested page tree, returning its ID, canonical link, and metadata. Omit workspaceId for your account and projectId for an ungrouped document. It does not publish or invite recipients; use publish_document or invite_share separately. Supporte

tools.name: update_document
tools.description: Updates supplied document fields using expectedRevision for conflict detection; omitted fields are preserved. A supplied pages array is authoritative: existing pages absent from it are deleted and require mcp:delete. Returns the saved snapshot and revision, or a saved receipt with complete:false for

tools.name: move_document
tools.description: Move a document to a project, or pass projectId:null to remove its project association. Optional workspaceId changes its owning workspace. Requires the current expectedRevision plus write and sharing access; moving can change inherited access. Returns the saved snapshot or an oversized-save receipt.

tools.name: publish_document
tools.description: Set a document to DRAFT or PUBLISHED using its current expectedRevision. accessScope controls RESTRICTED versus ANYONE access, and listedPublicly controls public listing; omitted settings are preserved. Requires write and sharing access and can expose content publicly. Returns the saved snapshot or

tools.name: archive_document
tools.description: Set a document’s status to ARCHIVED using its current expectedRevision. This changes lifecycle status without deleting its content or pages and requires write access. Returns the saved snapshot and revision, or an oversized-save receipt. Use delete_document only when deletion is intended.

tools.name: delete_document
tools.description: Delete a document and its pages by document ID, requiring deletion access. Returns the deleted document ID; it does not return a content backup. Use archive_document when the intent is to retain the content with archived status.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a project to organize documents in your personal or organization workspace. Returns its ID, metadata, instructions, and permissions; omit workspaceId for your account. Does not create documents or invite members. Use create_document with the returned projectId to add a document.

tools.name: update_project
tools.description: Update only the supplied name, description, or instructions of an existing project by ID; omitted fields are preserved. Requires write access and returns the updated project metadata and permissions. Use move_project to change its workspace or invite_share to grant access.

tools.name: move_project
tools.description: Move a project and its documents to the workspace identified by workspaceId from list_workspaces. Requires write and sharing access and can change inherited access to the project’s documents. Returns the updated project metadata and permissions. Use update_project for name, description, or instructi

tools.name: delete_project
tools.description: Delete a project by ID while retaining its documents and releasing them from the project. Inherited document access can change. Requires deletion, write, and sharing access and returns the deleted project ID; this does not delete the retained documents.

tools.name: list_shares
tools.description: List a page of direct access grants and pending invitations for a document or project. target selects which kind of ID to supply. Returns share IDs, recipient details, roles, statuses, deletion permissions, and pageInfo. Use these share IDs with update_share or remove_share; this is not organization

tools.name: invite_share
tools.description: Grant document or project access to one recipient identified by exactly one userId, email, or phone value. Requires sharing access and sends invitation notifications. Returns the share ID, recipient, role, and status. Use update_share for an existing grant; this does not add organization members.

tools.name: update_share
tools.description: Change the ADMIN, EDITOR, or VIEWER role of a direct access grant or pending invitation by share ID from list_shares. Requires sharing access and returns the updated share metadata. This can expand or reduce recipient access; use invite_share for a new recipient and remove_share to revoke a grant.

tools.name: remove_share
tools.description: Revoke a direct document/project access grant or pending invitation using its share ID from list_shares. Requires sharing access and returns the deleted share ID. Access inherited through another grant or project may remain; this does not remove organization membership.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

evidence.snippet: search
